title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Stories of Water and Flame
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume spin-off of Demon Slayer with two side stories. Giyu Tomioka and the Insect Hashira meet Yae, the daughter of a slain hunter, who believes a bear killed her father, though the truth is harder to face; and a young Kyojuro Rengoku takes an assignment to prove himself worthy of the Flame Hashira title his father abandoned, facing a demon with a grudge against that father. The volume also collects comic shorts based on the anime.
life_message: Duty, courage and facing hard truths honor one's family and protect others.
